steps.name: migrate-local-agent-registry
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
REG="$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories.json"
BACKUP="$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories.json.pre-matrixhub-20260827"
ADMIN="$HOME/local-agent/agent_repo_admin.py"
[ -f "$REG" ]
cp -p "$REG" "$BACKUP"
rollback() {
  rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "migration failed rc=$rc; restoring registry" >&2
    cp -p "$BACKUP" "$REG" || true
  fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback EXIT

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
reg = Path.home() / "Library" / "Application Support" / "local-agent" / "repositories.json"
payload = json.loads(reg.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if payload.get("version") != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f"unsupported registry version: {payload.get('version')!r}")
repos = payload.get("repositories")
if not isinstance(repos, list):
    raise SystemExit("registry repositories must be a list")
photo = [r for r in repos if r.get("id") == "photomaps"]
if len(photo) != 1 or photo[0].get("repository") != "MichalMatu/PhotoMaps":
    raise SystemExit(f"expected exact photomaps entry, got {photo!r}")
matrix = [r for r in repos if r.get("id") == "matrixhub"]
if matrix:
    if len(matrix) != 1 or matrix[0].get("repository") != "MichalMatu/MatrixHub":
        raise SystemExit(f"conflicting matrixhub entry: {matrix!r}")
else:
    repos.append({"id": "matrixhub", "repository": "MichalMatu/MatrixHub"})
text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="repositories.", suffix=".tmp", dir=reg.parent)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, reg)
finally:
    try:
        os.unlink(tmp)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
PY

python3 "$ADMIN" --registry "$REG" validate
python3 "$ADMIN" --registry "$REG" provision --repository-id matrixhub
python3 "$ADMIN" --registry "$REG" validate --repository-id matrixhub

CONTROL="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/matrixhub/control"
WORK="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/matrixhub/work"
[ "$(git -C "$CONTROL" branch --show-current)" = "agent-control" ]
[ "$(git -C "$WORK" branch --show-current)" = "main" ]
git -C "$CONTROL" remote get-url origin
git -C "$WORK" remote get-url origin

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
reg = Path.home() / "Library" / "Application Support" / "local-agent" / "repositories.json"
payload = json.loads(reg.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
repos = payload["repositories"]
matrix = [r for r in repos if r.get("id") == "matrixhub"]
if len(matrix) != 1 or matrix[0].get("repository") != "MichalMatu/MatrixHub":
    raise SystemExit(f"matrixhub entry missing or invalid: {matrix!r}")
photo = [r for r in repos if r.get("id") == "photomaps"]
if len(photo) != 1 or photo[0].get("repository") != "MichalMatu/PhotoMaps":
    raise SystemExit(f"photomaps entry changed unexpectedly: {photo!r}")
payload["repositories"] = [r for r in repos if r.get("id") != "photomaps"]
text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="repositories.", suffix=".tmp", dir=reg.parent)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, reg)
finally:
    try:
        os.unlink(tmp)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
PY

python3 "$ADMIN" --registry "$REG" validate
python3 "$ADMIN" --registry "$REG" list
trap - EXIT
echo "MIGRATION_OK"
echo "backup=$BACKUP"
